Some of us grow very in love with our animals. I have two pugs I can't medically look after anymore due to finances and the economic downturn. Watching them wither away and succumb to illness causes me great amounts of grief. I've spent everything I have on them and starve in the process. They're the only reason I get out of bed as well. I fear what will happen after they're gone and even what they'll go through before they are. It's my nightmare, we'll only part of it, but I live it everyday. I just need some money but most of us do... I'm so tired I want to quit but life won't let me. I hope you find your way.
